classifications.rationale: The President assigns the Secretary discretionary authority to operate and administer the railroad; this is an internal executive authority assignment, with no specified legal consequence imposed on private parties by this segment itself.
classifications.evidence: The Secretary of Transportation is authorized to operate and administer the Alaska Railroad

classifications.rationale: The segment internally allocates and limits the Secretary’s rate-setting authority by making it subject to the Commission’s authority; it does not itself set a rate or dictate a later specified rate outcome.
classifications.evidence: shall be subject to the authority of the Interstate Commerce Commission

classifications.rationale: This single segment inseparably combines discretionary authority assignments and administrative duties with present legal consequences, including shipper access to filed contracts, preservation of existing rates, and statutory-compliance status.
